notes.title: Development Update | 13.05.24
notes.content:
Hello, Dragon Lovers! 

We've poured our hearts into our work over the past several months and we're thrilled to finally unveil Development Update 2! This update is packed with new features and improvements we've been eager to show you.

Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so please feel free to share your thoughts and let us know how you feel about the progress we've made. We're excited to hear from you and continue improving with your support!

[h3]1) We improved the overall visual style of the game. [/h3]

Our visual style is our pride and joy, and we are tirelessly dedicated to refining and enhancing it.

Before

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/db13b4f2c20c74b3fd9e88c81bc002f4a2bedb32.gif[/img]

After (the image is smaller since Steam allows files only up to 5 MB, but you can check the full size on our socials)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/fcd2ed17f2d947c7f0992326823e4b38cb0ba81b.gif[/img]

[h3]2) Added more dragon animations.[/h3]

Both the Water and Fire Dragons have received exciting new animations. Take a look and see some of them in action!

Fire Dragon - Walking

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/3b3569b5466b9817e87a2f1040e832c6e6fa16f8.gif[/img]

Fire Dragon - Fire Breath

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/a6b4d054ab973215b4c2d8dd92ec44574bdd3de3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/aa90ba841711a917fdff120af9e1115829505cb6.gif[/img]

Fire Dragon - Asking for attention

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/94bd5e16d945339075329f865190a1933700335b.gif[/img]

Water dragon - jumping on a trampoline

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/aa498c5668782cfb64b5aa8c4ee8c922fc9df9a2.gif[/img]

[h3]3) We've made the farm and the town even cozier by sprinkling in some adorable new touches![/h3]

We've infused the farm and the town with even more charm by adding a variety of adorable new features! From quaint decorations to friendly little spots for gathering, each addition has been thoughtfully placed to enhance the warmth and welcoming atmosphere of these beloved places. Now, both the farm and the town are cozier than ever, inviting everyone to enjoy their enhanced beauty and comfort.

[h3]4) We dreamed up a bunch of delightful new critters![/h3]

We've let our imaginations soar and crafted a whole array of charming and intriguing new creatures, each with its own unique quirks and characteristics. These whimsical beings are designed to spark joy and wonder, adding an enchanting touch to our creative universe.

notes.title: Development Update | 26.02.24
notes.content:
Hello Dragon Enthusiasts and Fantasy Friends!

In our Dev Diaries, we've whisked you away to the whimsical world of Dragon Shelter, introducing you to its adorable dragons and their magical habitat. Now, we're super excited to sprinkle some fairy dust on our updates and give you a peek into the heart of the game itself – and all the progress we’ve made! 🐉✨

Check out our first development update! Here’s what we have been doing for the last few months:

[h3]We have created the first playable build[/h3]

We are not yet ready to show it to the players, but the first build is ready! In this build, you can work on a farm and interact with dragons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/70a6b74f4e93ddc4ef5d3dc4ab8e154925c2c922.png[/img]

This build features a variety of buildings you can explore on your farm, along with several charming dragons to meet and befriend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/abfee6ff02ce0e46147a00a9f18762df24ee6d17.png[/img]

And that's not all - the adventure extends beyond the farm; you can also step into the world of our main character by visiting their cozy house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/6ddbc7b7accf6360659566072d79c647504a6426.png[/img]

[h3]Crafting the Town and Its Inhabitants[/h3]

The next enchanting chapter in our build journey focuses on the town and its citizens! We've already laid the groundwork with detailed concepts for the town's design and its inhabitants. Currently, our creative energies are channeled into bringing these concepts to life through the development of 3D models.

Here’s our shopkeeper!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/16b18ce70df9ce9c0f81396f798d253dcf128168.png[/img]

And that’s what the city streets will look like! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/40161fb07dd673f535ee73550d4e52f80c28664b.png[/img]

[h3]We're Tuning the Soundscape![/h3]

Our team is joyfully weaving a magical tapestry of sounds to add an extra sprinkle of charm to our game's enchanting world. We're delighted to let you know that we've created a symphony of adorable soundtracks and lively sound effects (VFX), all designed to make the farm environment come alive with whimsy. Plus, we've lovingly crafted the main soundtrack, a musical hug that perfectly encapsulates the heartwarming adventure of our game!

[h3]Making Dragons into Delightful Helpers![/h3]

We're currently guiding our adorable dragons in learning basic activities, turning them into the most charming and helpful buddies.

The dragon is cutting a tree 🪓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/0c1d6c6569ab30328be1459604098672373f575d.gif[/img]

The dragon is mining 💎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/7143199d19c57d9bfb73f1d5306e88bd8cb991e0.gif[/img]

The dragon is cooking 🥘

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/5c68c1eaedfc875c624447c9e1789aa0eaaf69e5.gif[/img]

[h3]Crafting Heartwarming Cutscenes[/h3]

In Dragon Shelter, we're weaving together cutscenes that are not just visually stunning but also brimming with emotion. These special moments are designed to capture the very soul of our game, enveloping players in a world where every scene is a heartfelt journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/28ee7f3dba6b40632dbe858cdda76acab839224e.gif[/img]

Our team is pouring love and creativity into these sequences, ensuring they resonate with the magical essence of the game and touch the hearts of our players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44785713/d63bf280dfecfcda301cec9acf2b5005e0749ad1.gif[/img]

Thanks for Your Ongoing Support!

We're truly grateful for every bit of support. Stay tuned for more news about the game and its world. We appreciate you a lot! 🌟🐉💖
